* Inconsistent formatting or styling (e.g., font, spacing, indentation)

* Citation or referencing errors (e.g., APA, MLA, Chicago styles)
* Inconsistent terminology or language usage

My goal is to ensure that the text is error-free, clear, and concise, making it easier for readers to understand and engage with the content. I work with writers, editors, and publishers to refine their work and produce high-quality written materials, such as articles, books, reports, and other documents.
